Claims Department

Re: Claim C-1245
Our client: Lisa Patterson
Date of loss: 22 Dec 2024
Dear Claims Representative:
We are writing to confirm that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision described in
your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client
directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.
Our client was injured in a low-speed head-on collision and has been advised to undrego ongoing medical evaluation
and treatment. We will provide documentation of those injuries and related expenses as the claim develops.
To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request a complete written statement of the bodily injury and property
damage limits under each policy that may apply to this loss, including any excess or umbrella coverage. Please also
confirm the name and contact details of the adjuster assigned to the file.
We further ask that your insuerd and your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes
photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair and salvage records, recorded statements, claim
notes, and any dashcam or surveillance footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials
until this matter is resolved.
We look forward to your prompt written response.
Sincerely,
Jacob Holmes
Watson & Hines LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
